negative_example.description: This is a negative few-shot example to show what kind of causal chain should NOT be generated.
incorrect_output: Reactor mechanical failure causes Mechanical Failure
Continuous release causes Vapor cloud formation
Ignition source in distance causes Delayed Ignition

preferred_style.guideline: Use layered causal reasoning with physically meaningful intermediate nodes.
example_output: Feed -> Overheating -> Vapor expansion -> Overpressure -> BLEVE

negative_example.note: Do not imitate or repeat this incorrect style in the model output.
